goal: Promote a staged build: create released/v1, copy staging/app.txt to released/v1/app.txt, move staging/notes.txt to released/v1/notes.txt, then remove staging/app.txt so only the released copy survives. Return a record { made: <mkdir state>, copied: <copy state>, moved: <move state>, removed: <remove state> }.
notes: Every mutation verb is a rename: file.remove and file.move retain the previous bytes in Hold, so the attempt records at least one held act.
